templates.title: API endpoint accessible without authentication
templates.remediation: Require authentication and authorization for endpoints that expose protected data or actions.

templates.title: API server technology disclosure
templates.remediation: Minimize unnecessary server/version disclosure in HTTP response headers.

templates.title: API advertises an undeclared HTTP method
templates.remediation: Review the Allow header and API contract; remove methods that are not intentionally exposed.

templates.title: OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint reachable without authentication
templates.remediation: Require an authenticated, authorized caller for any LLM inference/embeddings/model-listing endpoint - an unauthenticated 200 here typically means anyone can consume model quota or extract information about deployed models (OWASP API Security Top 10: Broken Authentication; OWASP LLM Top 10: LLM10 Unbounded Consumption).

templates.title: OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint discovered
templates.remediation: Presence alone is not a vulnerability - confirm this route is intentionally exposed and covered by the same access controls as other sensitive API surface.

templates.title: Agent-framework route (LangServe/agent/chain invoke) reachable without authentication
templates.remediation: Agent/tool-invocation endpoints can trigger real side effects (tool calls, chained requests) - treat them like any other privileged action endpoint and require authentication/authorization (OWASP LLM Top 10: LLM08 Excessive Agency).

templates.title: Agent-framework route discovered
templates.remediation: Confirm this route is intentionally exposed and that any tool/function the agent can call is itself access-controlled.

templates.title: LLM endpoint has no visible rate-limit signaling
templates.remediation: Add rate-limit signaling and enforcement in front of LLM-backed endpoints to reduce resource/cost exhaustion risk (OWASP LLM Top 10: LLM10 Unbounded Consumption).
